name: Vegetable garden
about: Rows of wheat, carrots, potatoes and beetroot around a square of water, with a fence to keep animals out.

layers.name: Water and farmland
layers.tip: On flat grass, dig one block in the middle and fill it with water. Use a hoe on the grass around it to make farmland, 5 by 5. Leave a ring of grass around the edge.

layers.name: Plant and fence
layers.tip: Plant a row of each crop: wheat seeds, carrots, potatoes, beetroot seeds, then wheat again. Put a fence on the grass all around, with a gate at the front.

layers.name: Lights
layers.tip: A torch on each corner post helps the crops grow at night.
